p: Ettrick Square is part of Cumbernauld's town centre, the famous 1960s concrete megastructure that was designed to put everything under one roof. Love it or hate it, it's one of the most talked about buildings in Scotland, and the newer Antonine Centre is right next door.

Cumbernauld was the setting for the 1981 film Gregory's Girl, and the town is surrounded by green space. Palacerigg Country Park, on the edge of town, has walking trails and a golf course, and stretches of the Antonine Wall run nearby.
Clyde Leisure is an 18+ venue, so it's adults only.
